title: On modular vector invariant fields
summary: Let $\mathbb{F}_q$ be a finite field of any characteristic and $\rm GL(n,\mathbb{F}_q)$ the general linear group over $\mathbb{F}_q$. Suppose $W$ denotes the standard representation of $\rm GL(n,\mathbb{F}_q)$ and $\rm GL(n,\mathbb{F}_q)$ acts diagonally on the direct sum of $W$ and its dual space $W^*$. Let $G$ be any subgroup of $\rm GL(n,\mathbb{F}_q)$. Suppose the invariant field $\mathbb{F}_q(W)^G=\mathbb{F}_q(f_1,f_2,\dots,f_k)$, where $f_1,f_2,\dots,f_k\in\mathbb{F}_q[W]^G$ are homogeneous invariant polynomials.
